assay: bulk mRNA-seq (paired-end TruSeq) of 4T1 subcutaneous mammary tumours
sample_inclusion: 5 exercise (E, 21 days voluntary wheel running) + 5 non-exercise (NE) tumour-bearing mice; tumours collected at day 21 (S2.2.p1, S3.1.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of 21 days of voluntary wheel running on gene expression in 4T1 breast tumours: E vs NE (S2.2.p1, S3.1.p1, Figure 1B-D)
planned_contrasts: E vs NE in tumour tissue (S3.1.p1; paper: 22 DEGs; Cd300e down, 46% of NE, p = 0.008)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one tumour per animal, animals randomised into two independent groups (S2.2.p1). S3.1.p1 says 'five matched pairs' but no pairing variable exists and animals were randomised independently
normalization: HISAT2 -> StringTie FPKM; TMM normalisation for library size (S2.3.p1)
paper_method: TMM-normalised differential expression (tool not named; TMM implies edgeR); DEG = fold change >= 2 and FDR <= 0.05 (S2.3.p1-p2)

named_genes.Cd300e: down in E, 46% of NE, p = 0.008

paper_enrichment: KEGG/GO on DEGs and GSEA (S2.3.p2, S3.1.p1)
